text_en: Now there was a Pharisee named Nicodemus, a leader of the Jews.
text_cn: 有一个法利塞党人，名叫尼苛德摩，是个犹太人的首领。

text_en: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God; for no one can do these signs that you do apart from the presence of God. ”
text_cn: 有一夜，他来到耶稣前，向他说：“辣彼，我们知道你是由天主而来的师傅，因为天主若不同他在一起，谁也不能行你所行的这些神迹。”

text_en: Jesus answered him, “Very truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God without being born from above. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我实实在在告诉你：人除非由上而生，不能见到天主的国。”

text_en: Nicodemus said to him, “How can anyone be born after having grown old? Can one enter a second time into the mother’s womb and be born? ”
text_cn: 尼苛德摩说：“人已年老，怎样能重生呢？难道他还能再入母腹而重生吗？”

text_en: Jesus answered, “Very truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God without being born of water and Spirit.
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我实实在在告诉你：人除非由水和圣神而生，不能进天主的国：

text_en: What is born of the flesh is flesh, and what is born of the Spirit is spirit.
text_cn: 由肉生的属于肉，由神生的属于神。

text_en: Do not be astonished that I said to you, ‘You must be born from above. ’
text_cn: 你不要惊奇，因我给你说了：你们应该由上而生。

text_en: The wind blows where it chooses, and you hear the sound of it, but you do not know where it comes from or where it goes. So it is with everyone who is born of the Spirit. ”
text_cn: 风随意向那里吹，你听到风的响声，却不知道风从哪里来，往哪里去：凡由圣神而生的就是这样。”

text_en: Nicodemus said to him, “How can these things be? ”
text_cn: 尼苛德摩问说：“这事怎样能成就呢？”

text_en: Jesus answered him, “Are you a teacher of Israel, and yet you do not understand these things?
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“你是以色列的师傅，连这事你都不知道吗？

text_en: “Very truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know and testify to what we have seen; yet you do not receive our testimony.
text_cn: 我实实在在告诉你：我们知道的，我们才讲论；我们见过的，我们才作证；而你们却不接受我们的见证。

text_en: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how can you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
text_cn: 若我给你们说地上的事，你们尚且不信；若我给你们说天上的事，你们怎么会信呢？

text_en: No one has ascended into heaven except the one who descended from heaven, the Son of Man.
text_cn: 没有人上过天，除了那自天降下而仍在天上的人子。

text_en: And just as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up,
text_cn: 正如梅瑟曾在旷野里高举了蛇，人子也应照样被举起来，

text_en: that whoever believes in him may have eternal life.
text_cn: 使凡信的人，在他内得永生。”

text_en: “For God so loved the world that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who believes in him may not perish but may have eternal life.
text_cn: 天主竟这样爱了世界，甚至赐下了自己的独生子，使凡信他的人不至丧亡，反而获得永生，

text_en: “Indeed, God did not send the Son into the world to condemn the world, but in order that the world might be saved through him.
text_cn: 因为天主没有派遣子到世界上来审判世界，而是为叫世界藉着他而获救。

text_en: Those who believe in him are not condemned; but those who do not believe are condemned already, because they have not believed in the name of the only Son of God.
text_cn: 那信从他的，不受审判；那不信的，已受了审判，因为他没有信从天主独生子的名字。

text_en: And this is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and people loved darkness rather than light because their deeds were evil.
text_cn: 审判就在于此：光明来到了世界，世人却爱黑暗甚于光明，因为他们的行为是邪恶的。

text_en: For all who do evil hate the light and do not come to the light, so that their deeds may not be exposed.
text_cn: 的确，凡作恶的，都憎恶光明，也不来就光明，怕自己的行为彰显出来；

text_en: But those who do what is true come to the light, so that it may be clearly seen that their deeds have been done in God. ”
text_cn: 然而履行真理的，却来就光明，为显示出他的行为是在天主内完成的。

text_en: After this Jesus and his disciples went into the Judean countryside, and he spent some time there with them and baptized.
text_cn: 此后，耶稣和门徒来到犹太地，同他们一起住在那里施洗。

text_en: John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim because water was abundant there; and people kept coming and were being baptized
text_cn: 那时若翰也在临近撒林的艾农施洗，因为那里水多，人们常来受洗。

text_en: —John, of course, had not yet been thrown into prison.
text_cn: 那时，若翰尚未被投在监狱里。

text_en: Now a discussion about purification arose between John’s disciples and a Jew.
text_cn: 若翰的门徒和一个犹太人，关于取洁礼发生了争辩。

text_en: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, the one who was with you across the Jordan, to whom you testified, here he is baptizing, and all are going to him. ”
text_cn: 他们便来到若翰前对他说：“辣彼！曾同你一起在约但河对岸，你给他作证的那位，看，他也施洗；并且众人都到他那里去了。”

text_en: John answered, “No one can receive anything except what has been given from heaven.
text_cn: 若翰回答说：“人不能领受什么，除非有天上的赏赐。

text_en: You yourselves are my witnesses that I said, ‘I am not the Messiah, but I have been sent ahead of him. ’
text_cn: 你们自己可以给我作证，我曾说过：我不是默西亚，我只是被派遣作他前驱的。

text_en: He who has the bride is the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly at the bridegroom’s voice. For this reason my joy has been fulfilled.
text_cn: 有新娘的是新郎；新郎的朋友，侍立静听，一听得新郎的声音，就非常喜乐：我的喜乐已满足了。

text_en: He must increase, but I must decrease. ”
text_cn: 他应该兴盛，我却应该衰微。”

text_en: The one who comes from above is above all; the one who is of the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all.
text_cn: 那由上而来的，超越一切。那出于下地的，是属于下地，且讲论下地的事；那自上天而来的，超越万有之上，

text_en: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, yet no one accepts his testimony.
text_cn: 他对所见所闻的，予以作证，却没有人接受他的见证。

text_en: Whoever has accepted his testimony has certified this, that God is true.
text_cn: 那接受他见证的人，就是证实天主是真实的。

text_en: He whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for he gives the Spirit without measure.
text_cn: 天主所派遣的，讲论天主的话，因为天主把圣神无限量地赏赐了他。

text_en: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in his hands.
text_cn: 父爱子，并把一切交在他手中。

text_en: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life; whoever disobeys the Son will not see life, but must endure God’s wrath.
text_cn: 那信从子的，便有永生；那不信从子的，不但不会见到生命，反有天主的义怒常在他身上。
